summary: The great tome of demonology: power over fiends, and the danger of what's bound in its pages.
text: An expansive treatise documenting the Abyss's infinite layers and inhabitants, the Demonomicon of Iggwilv is the most thorough and blasphemous tome of demonology in the multiverse. While attuned to it you can use it as a Spellcasting Focus and you have Advantage on saving throws against the abilities of Fiends. Once per dawn each, you can cast Magic Circle at level 9, Planar Binding and Summon Fiend at level 9 from it. A demon is bound within its pages and may try to break free when its reader is weakened. The book has one minor beneficial property and one minor detrimental property.
